origine_fr: À gauche, 讠, la parole ; à droite, 炎, deux feux 火, qui donnait le son mais se lit yán. Ce sont des paroles échangées. C'est parler, discuter.
origine_en: On the left, 讠, speech; on the right, 炎, two fires 火, which gave the sound but is read yán. These are words exchanged. It means to talk, to discuss.

phrase.en: I'd like to have a talk with you.
